			change_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m132_debt_due_cycle add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m132_debt_status value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m132_debt_audit_state value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_m132_debt_business_object_created value = 0 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_portfolio_deferred value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_deferred_cleanup_status value = 1 }
			change_variable = { name = zg361_cp_policy_debt_open_n add = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_applied value = 1 }
			set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 1 }

		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_cycle

						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_case

						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_cycle

				}
			}
			zg361_case_r_advance_04_effect = {
				TICKET_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
				TICKET_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
				TICKET_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
				TICKET_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
			}
		}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_r_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_r_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_r_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_r_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_r_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_r_active

				EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

				EXPECTED_STATE = 4
			}
			NOT = {
				OR = {
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
						EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$
						EXPECTED_CYCLE = $TICKET_CYCLE$
						EXPECTED_CASE = $TICKET_CASE$
						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_state
						RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_choice
						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
					}
					zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
						RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_owner
						RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_subject
						RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_cycle
						RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_case
						RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_state

						EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$

						EXPECTED_STATE = 4
						EXPECTED_CHOICE = 3
					}
				}
			}
			NOT = {
				trigger_if = {
					limit = {
						has_variable = zg361_cp_r_operation_total
						has_variable = zg361_cp_r_operation_used
					}
					var:zg361_cp_r_operation_used < var:zg361_cp_r_operation_total
				}
				trigger_else = { always = no }
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_last_red_code value = 1323 }
		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 4 } # typed RED; no receipt, business or resource write
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			zg361_case_kernel_full_guard_trigger = {
				OWNER_VAR = zg361_case_r_owner
				SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_case_r_subject
				CYCLE_VAR = zg361_case_r_cycle_serial
				CASE_VAR = zg361_case_r_case_serial
				STATE_VAR = zg361_case_r_state
				ACTIVE_VAR = zg361_case_r_active

					EXPECTED_STATE = 4
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 1
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_state
					RECEIPT_CHOICE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_choice
					EXPECTED_OWNER = $TICKET_OWNER$
					EXPECTED_SUBJECT = $TICKET_SUBJECT$

					EXPECTED_STATE = 4
					EXPECTED_CHOICE = 2
				}
				zg361_case_kernel_receipt_is_current_trigger = {
					RECEIPT_OWNER_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_owner
					RECEIPT_SUBJECT_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_subject
					RECEIPT_CYCLE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_cycle
					RECEIPT_CASE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_case
					RECEIPT_STATE_VAR = zg361_cp_m132_receipt_state

		set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 2 } # idempotent no-op
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = zg361_cp_runtime_status value = 3 } } # stale no-op
}
